title: Personalized Study Planner
description: A day-by-day schedule built around your target exam, your current syllabus coverage, and how many hours you actually have — not a generic timetable.

title: Weekly 1:1 Review Calls
description: A direct phone call every week with your mentor to walk through progress, adjust the plan, and answer what's blocking you before it costs another week.

title: Error / Lag Notebook Audit
description: Every mistake and guessed answer goes into a lag notebook — your mentor reviews it directly, the same method RP Sir used on his way to AIR 179.

title: Test Analysis, the "2x Rule" Way
description: Analysis time should be double your attempt time. Your mentor sits with you on that breakdown so no wrong answer goes unexamined.

title: Weak-Area & Revision Priority Tracking
description: High-weightage subjects get 3–5 revision passes, everything else gets at least 2 — your mentor tracks the count so nothing important is under-revised.

title: Career-Path Guidance, Included
description: Not sure GATE is the right track, or which state exam to prioritize? Your mentor helps you decide, backed by RankersPro's Career Guidance program.
